name: postflowx
description: PostFlowX — VFX Post Production Desktop App
author: PostFlowX
_targets: Two build targets share the same renderer source. See PROJECT_MAP.md.

scripts.test:js: for f in tests-js/*.test.mjs; do echo "• $f"; node "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:js && (cd companion && python3 -m pytest -q) && (cd postflowx-adobe && npm test)
scripts.build:extension: node build-renderer.js --target extension && echo 'Load dist/extension/ as unpacked extension in chrome://extensions'
scripts.build:avf: bash -c 'set -e; swiftc electron/native/avf_bridge.swift -o electron/native/avf_bridge_arm64 -target arm64-apple-macos12.0 -framework AVFoundation -framework Foundation -framework CoreGraphics -framework ImageIO && swiftc electron/native/avf_bridge.swift -o electron/native/avf_bridge_x86 -target x86_64-apple-macos12.0 -framework AVFoundation -framework Foundation -framework CoreGraphics -framework ImageIO && lipo -create electron/native/avf_bridge_arm64 electron/native/avf_bridge_x86 -output electron/native/avf_bridge && rm electron/native/avf_bridge_arm64 electron/native/avf_bridge_x86 && chmod +x electron/native/avf_bridge && echo "[avf_bridge] universal binary built"'
scripts.build:avf:arm64: swiftc electron/native/avf_bridge.swift -o electron/native/avf_bridge -target arm64-apple-macos12.0 -framework AVFoundation -framework Foundation -framework CoreGraphics -framework ImageIO && chmod +x electron/native/avf_bridge
scripts.build:native-engine: bash -c 'set -e; cd electron/native/PFXNativeMediaEngine && swift build -c release --arch arm64 && swift build -c release --arch x86_64 && lipo -create .build/arm64-apple-macosx/release/PFXNativeMediaEngine .build/x86_64-apple-macosx/release/PFXNativeMediaEngine -output ../pfx_native_media_engine && chmod +x ../pfx_native_media_engine && echo "[PFXNativeMediaEngine] universal binary built"'
scripts.build:native-engine:arm64: bash -c 'set -e; cd electron/native/PFXNativeMediaEngine && swift build -c release --arch arm64 && cp .build/arm64-apple-macosx/release/PFXNativeMediaEngine ../pfx_native_media_engine && chmod +x ../pfx_native_media_engine && echo "[PFXNativeMediaEngine] arm64 binary built"'
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:avf && npm run build:native-engine && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:mac-dir: npm run build:avf && npm run build:native-engine && npm run build:renderer && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir -c.mac.identity=null -c.mac.notarize=false
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:avf && npm run build:native-engine && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --mac --universal
scripts.dist:mac:unsigned: npm run build:avf && npm run build:native-engine && npm run build:renderer && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg --universal -c.mac.identity=null -c.mac.notarize=false

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: PostFlowX uses the microphone for the Voice command feature.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: PostFlowX controls DaVinci Resolve to decode and preview camera-original (OCF) frames.
